servers.add_all_added: Every project is already in Server control

add_site.title: Add a website
add_site.credential_hint: The app signs the agent in with it. The values never reach the model, a snapshot or a screenshot.
add_site.credential_empty: Your vault has no credentials yet
add_site.credential_form_found: The scan found a sign-in form, so signing in is possible.
add_site.credential_form_missing: The scan found no sign-in form, so signing in is not possible yet.
add_site.policy_hint: Force a tool to ask you first. You can always tighten; you can never loosen a tool below what the page itself implies.
add_site.policy_no_tools: This site publishes no tools of its own
add_site.budget_hint: How many calls an agent may make on this site in one turn.
add_site.budget_invalid: A budget is a whole number, 0 or more.
add_site.origin_hint: Scheme and host only, with an optional port. No path, no query.
add_site.label_hint: What you call this site. The address is used when you leave it blank.
add_site.scan_now_hint: Opens the site once with read-only tools to grade how much of it an agent can work. Nothing is enabled by a scan.
add_site.pattern_hint_subdomain: the site and every subdomain under it
add_site.pattern_hint_example: added for you as an example. Remove it if you do not want it.
add_site.origin_error_url: That is a full web address. Keep the scheme, the host and an optional port, and drop the rest.
add_site.origin_error_wildcard: A * is only allowed as a leading *. on the host, or as the whole port.
